title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, g side sieved, exact descent strip, re-optimised plan, ntt3 prices: 2^89.763816706

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^91.119551521 < 2^89.763816706 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7207802480818105624, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.998117 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^112 units that aborts as failure. The ledger charges that phase at its expected work, at most 2^87.175527 units by the descent recurrence (H5), because the work before an abort never exceeds the uncapped work; and the two-variable Samuels bound of proof.md section 7 on the two independent logarithm works gives P(cap) <= 0.000000034 and opened-run success at least 0.998117. Work and success both rest on H5 as modeled, with no allowance factor. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute field, collection, filtering, descent and ledger arithmetic (default {}); rebuild gives rounded declarations. Toy-scale checks, not production proofs (transfer is H5): part=pgf (862 PGF observations, also in the default run), porttoy (exact ball or parent/child/control), bw config 0..3 (seven-pad diagnostics), adaptive_stats (171 entered-node strata, also default), h5 (ADAPTIVE.md conditional tables, 627 attempts, from h5data.b85), threshold (judge counterexample and count tails), eatoy (gate A/E inputs, also default), plan (62-row plan, node budget, E[N], abort and repeat losses).
